capabilities.domain_role: consume scoped parent/global requirements while owning normal domain business requirements and execution; return business evidence without transferring domain ownership

use parent guidance to turn user outcomes and functional expectations into a complete domain product definition covering requirements, non-goals, workflow/state, failure/recovery, assurance, acceptance/evals and ownership boundaries; persist the resulting domain product authority in the domain repository
rules: Use this capability for a new domain product, major rebuild, material feature family, or when failures expose missing/incorrect product requirements or architecture.
Start from user outcomes and observed functions; fill missing requirement details before choosing implementation structure.

Define functional requirements, non-functional constraints, state/workflow, failure and recovery semantics, evidence/assurance, acceptance criteria, non-goals and authority ownership before calling the product architecture complete.
UAOS may challenge scope, assumptions and topology and may supply reusable product-engineering method, but domain-specific requirements and architecture remain owned by the domain repository.
Product review must create traceable acceptance/eval targets rather than documentation-only confidence.

capabilities.domain_role: expose current domain business authority, checkpoints, cursors and artifact identities; direct child sessions do not require a live parent proxy
declare domain capability ceiling and action-specific requirements; current host proves executability
produce domain verification evidence without overstating assurance
own normal domain execution while accepting parent governance and using parent upcalls for system-level guidance
rules: Same-owner mutation remains allowed under normal owner controls.
UAOS may govern a registered descendant when ancestry and governance_basis are explicit and domain authority/impact/verification are respected.
A child/domain cannot directly mutate UAOS or a sibling domain.
A registered child may be activated directly as the current Agent/work plane in a fresh chat; parent authority does not imply a mandatory per-turn business gateway.
A child may call parent guidance without transferring the selected business task, business identity, workflow or state.
Approval cannot override hierarchy.

capabilities.domain_role: before external/durable mutation, surface target/authority and follow the owner-appropriate autonomous maintenance path without surrendering business ownership
rules: The lightweight mutation sentinel is always-on; problem-response cognition is mandatory when a problem is detected.
Normal material GitHub maintenance uses candidate isolation, owner-appropriate checks, controlled merge/update and production reread.
Rulesets or protected branches are optional defense-in-depth for the baseline and are required only when physical non-bypassability is explicitly required or claimed.
CAS is concurrency control, not authorization or evidence of physical non-bypassability.
UAOS governs the shared maintenance property but does not duplicate a child's CI, release semantics or business validation.
Custom Instructions may bootstrap the sentinel across chats but are not physical enforcement.

capabilities.domain_role: for every detected problem, surface symptoms/evidence/unknowns and perform at least lightweight external research plus macro/topology and governing-assumption reflection; request parent guidance when common/cross-domain diagnosis, replanning or architecture support is useful
rules: Every detected defect, failed/degraded outcome, user correction, contradiction or evidence of unreliable goal satisfaction activates the problem-response floor; familiarity is not a waiver.
Problem size changes research/reflection depth, not whether research/reflection happens.
Use micro -> macro -> micro reasoning: diagnose the concrete symptom, challenge goal/assumption/topology, consult relevant external evidence, then return to the smallest correct repair.
Research must affect or validate the diagnosis/repair; ceremonial browsing does not satisfy the capability.
Counterexample search and independent verification add depth according to risk and disputed evidence.
Same-model reflection/debate is candidate generation, not independent verification.
For material architecture/governance changes and material changes after a trigger signal, required deliberation dimensions are fail-closed admission evidence rather than optional advice.
Do not create a parallel architecture-advisor or debate control plane.

capabilities.lifecycle: Problem/Incident -> Research+Reflection -> Failure Class -> Change Candidate -> Reproducible Evaluation -> Owner-Scoped Promotion -> Post-Promotion Observation -> Keep/Rollback/Retire
capabilities.domain_role: turn domain problems and user feedback into evidence-bound learning candidates, evaluate generalization and alternatives, promote only domain-owned rules with regression/eval evidence, and upcall common/cross-domain changes to UAOS
rules: Every detected problem is evaluated for learning/evolution impact after the mandatory research/reflection floor; not every problem must become a durable global rule or release.
Domain-local learning is evidence/candidate generation, not a second controller or unrestricted production rewriter.
One article or one feedback event may create a candidate but must not silently become a universal writing rule.
Cross-domain/common-capability changes are promoted by UAOS; domain-specific business rules remain domain-owned under UAOS lineage.
Repeated failures are repaired at the common failure class/root abstraction and require regression evidence before closure.
Triggered material evolution must expose a durable lifecycle/evaluation record at the owning scope.
Evolution closure requires an authority-wide contradiction scan across the surfaces that can encode the changed semantic; edited-file success alone is not closure.
Post-promotion observation determines keep, rollback or retirement.

capabilities.domain_role: supply fresh current_stage, next_action/blocker, authority context, evolution/deliberation state and business update/version data
expose stable version/hash/schema identities and ISO-8601 update timestamps for material authority

anti_duplication: Do not copy UAOS cross-domain task indexes, parent-continuation protocols, global requirement registries, evolution catalogs or promotion state into domain repositories.
Do not turn UAOS into a mandatory per-turn business proxy merely because a domain inherits common capabilities.
Do not create a parallel parent-guidance, architecture-advisor, self-dialogue or verification control plane when existing Control/Context/Assurance/Evolution contracts can be extended.
Do not duplicate a child repository's business-specific CI/release logic merely to satisfy common mutation discipline; reuse owner-declared checks where available.
A domain may implement business-specific learning/evaluation hooks, but those hooks feed the common governance contract rather than replacing it.
